SUN_S1E12_P01.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E12_P01.text: No, ma'am. My name is Kael Mack.

SUN_S1E12_P01.speaker: Veyra
SUN_S1E12_P01.text: Who told you he was coming?

SUN_S1E12_P01.speaker: Maela Crow
SUN_S1E12_P01.text: No. And before you ask, she did not look like you.

SUN_S1E12_P02.speaker: Maela Crow
SUN_S1E12_P02.text: Lysa made me promise I'd give this to Darrow.

SUN_S1E12_P02.speaker: Maela Crow
SUN_S1E12_P02.text: The woman described your face, your coat, even that thing you do when you want to leave.

SUN_S1E12_P02.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E12_P02.text: You stand half a step farther from everybody.

SUN_S1E12_P02.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E12_P02.text: Because it says Darrow Keene. Looking like him doesn't make his mail mine.

SUN_S1E12_P03.speaker: Veyra
SUN_S1E12_P03.text: This entry is five months before I first heard Kael's name.

SUN_S1E12_P03.speaker: Samuel
SUN_S1E12_P03.text: And I met Veyra after that.

SUN_S1E12_P03.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E12_P03.text: So neither of you could have planted this one.

SUN_S1E12_P03.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E12_P03.text: Could the Varnok story have traveled backward somehow?

SUN_S1E12_P03.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E12_P03.text: You checked that date three times.

SUN_S1E12_P03.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E12_P03.text: You only moved your finger three.

SUN_S1E12_P03.speaker: Veyra
SUN_S1E12_P03.text: I checked once before you came in.

SUN_S1E12_P03.speaker: Maela Crow
SUN_S1E12_P03.text: If it helps, I have been sick of this promise since winter.

SUN_S1E12_P03.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E12_P03.text: The traveler. Green scarf, shaved temple.

SUN_S1E12_P03.speaker: Maela Crow
SUN_S1E12_P03.text: If I had, I would have given her the packet and made it her problem.

SUN_S1E12_P04.speaker: Veyra
SUN_S1E12_P04.text: We still have to consider that Kael knows more than he says.

SUN_S1E12_P04.speaker: Veyra
SUN_S1E12_P04.text: You cannot account for his whole life.

SUN_S1E12_P04.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E12_P04.text: I don't need his whole life.

SUN_S1E12_P04.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E12_P04.text: Of course they can. That is not the same as being a different person every time somebody wants one.

SUN_S1E12_P04.speaker: Samuel
SUN_S1E12_P04.text: I believe the point is that Darrow is now the interesting part.

SUN_S1E12_P04.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E12_P04.text: I preferred being the boring part.

SUN_S1E12_P05.speaker: Maela Crow
SUN_S1E12_P05.text: I wanted you to be him.

SUN_S1E12_P05.speaker: Maela Crow
SUN_S1E12_P05.text: Then I could be finished with this.

SUN_S1E12_P05.speaker: Maela Crow
SUN_S1E12_P05.text: Lysa died believing he'd come. I promised her.

SUN_S1E12_P05.speaker: Maela Crow
SUN_S1E12_P05.text: So what am I supposed to do with it?

SUN_S1E12_P05.speaker: Maela Crow
SUN_S1E12_P05.text: The preacher would have something better.

SUN_S1E12_P05.speaker: Samuel
SUN_S1E12_P05.text: I am trying very hard not to.

SUN_S1E12_P05.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E12_P05.text: I only know I'm not Darrow. Opening it for me won't make your promise complete.

SUN_S1E12_P05.speaker: Maela Crow
SUN_S1E12_P05.text: So I still have to decide.

SUN_S1E12_P06.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E12_P06.text: The page that says 'Who is Kael?'

SUN_S1E12_P06.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E12_P06.text: That is a mildly alarming answer.

SUN_S1E12_P06.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E12_P06.text: The question is somewhere else now.

SUN_S1E12_P06.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E12_P06.text: Why do people keep getting a version of him before he gets there?

SUN_S1E12_P06.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E12_P06.text: I was hoping we'd stop having a question.

SUN_S1E12_P06.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E12_P06.text: I still don't particularly need one.

SUN_S1E12_P06.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E12_P06.text: What are you writing at the top?

SUN_S1E12_P06.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E12_P06.text: Best thing you've written all day.
